validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <!-- bad -- comment -->
  <state id="a"><transition event="go" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: `--` is not allowed inside a comment

notes: XML reserves `--` inside comments (for SGML compatibility), so a comment cannot contain it or end with `--->`
diagnostics.help: use a single `-` inside comments, and leave a space before the closing `-->`

fixes.message: collapse repeated hyphens in the comment
